Thanks for the heads up. This is a known edge-case: when invites originate from group/alias accounts the Meet token sometimes drops for domains with strict calendar ingestion. Options in order of preference: 

1) Recreate the invite from your named account (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com). Google will generate a stable Meet token for external guests.

2) If you prefer not to re-create, provide a temporary Zoom meeting link and attach an .ics that forces the alternative join URL for external guests. We'll also add the Zoom as the event description and include the passcode.

3) Last-resort: ask them to join via the shared attendee link in the calendar web UI (messy).

I can generate an ICS and a Zoom meeting now — if you want, I'll create a one-off Zoom for Tue 7/22 11:00am PT with passcode 8421 and send the ICS + short instructions. We'll also include a note to reissue future invites from named users for Hightower so they don't see this again.
